title: Complaints and feedback
meta.description: Sign in to submit software bugs, order, license, download or account issues and track private progress in My tickets.
hero.title: Every issue is handled with care
hero.description: Submit software bugs, order and payment issues, license and device problems, download and installation failures, or product suggestions. Requests are private to you and authorized support staff.
hero.note: Choose a category to open the ticket form. Support replies appear in My tickets.
preparation.title: Before you submit
preparation.heading: Help us resolve your issue faster
preparation.software: For software issues, include the version, system, reproduction steps and screenshots.
preparation.order: For order issues, include the order number, payment time and method.
preparation.private: Only you and authorized support staff can view your submission.
category.heading: Choose an issue category
category.description: Select a category to open the ticket form and provide more details.
category.bug.title: Software bug or crash
category.bug.description: Crashes, rendering errors, abnormal behavior, or a reproducible performance issue.
category.purchase.title: Orders, payments and refunds
category.purchase.description: Order status, payment not credited, duplicate charge, refund, invoice, or wallet issue.
category.license.title: Licensing and devices
category.license.description: Activation, trial, device session, offline credential, or an unexpected license restriction.
category.download.title: Downloads and installation
category.download.description: Broken download, missing file, extraction failure, installer error, or first-run problem.
category.account.title: Account and sign-in
category.account.description: Registration, sign-in, verification, password reset, or contact binding.
category.suggestion.title: Product suggestion
category.suggestion.description: A workflow improvement, usability issue, output-format request, or new feature idea.
category.other.title: Other complaint
category.other.description: A service issue or another problem that does not match the categories above.
form.files.error: Up to five attachments, each no more than 5 MB.
form.too_long: The description plus diagnostic details exceed 5,000 characters. Shorten the description.
form.partial: Feedback created. {uploaded} attachments uploaded; retry the rest from ticket details.
form.submit_error: Could not submit feedback. Check the input and try again.
form.order_missing: That order number does not belong to your account.
form.auth_required: Your session expired. Sign in again to submit.
form.title: Feedback details
field.subject: Subject
field.subject.placeholder: Summarize the issue in one sentence
field.order.help: Only a 16-digit order number belonging to this account is accepted.
field.description.placeholder: Include reproduction steps, expected and actual results. For order issues, include the order time and payment method.
field.sensitive: Do not submit passwords, verification codes, payment secrets or full payment credentials.
attachment.title: Attachments
attachment.optional: optional, up to five files, 5 MB each
attachment.add: Add screenshots, logs or order evidence
attachment.help: PDF, JPG, PNG, ZIP and TXT are supported. Attachments remain private.
agreement.prefix: I have read and agree to
sidebar.bug: Bug: version, OS, GPU, reproduction steps, screenshots or logs.
sidebar.order: Order: 16-digit order number, order time, payment method and error message.
sidebar.license: License: account, device digest and last successful online check.
sidebar.sensitive: Never upload passwords, verification codes, API keys or full card details.
response.title: Response guide
privacy.title: Privacy boundary
privacy.description: This site has no public feedback hall and never displays your request to other users. See the
success.title: Your feedback is queued for review
success.description: View support replies and status changes in My tickets, where you can continue the conversation.
form.after_submission: After submission, follow progress and support replies in your private ticket history. Requests are visible only to you and authorized support staff.
